world.desc: The battlefield now: every robot and bullet

turns.desc: How many turns to play in this call

atan2_r.body: if a = 0 and b = 0 then 0 else if abs(b) >= abs(a) then (if b > 0 then atan_r(a / b) else if a >= 0 then atan_r(a / b) + 3.141592653589793 else atan_r(a / b) - 3.141592653589793) else (if a > 0 then 3.141592653589793 / 2 - atan_r(b / a) else -3.141592653589793 / 2 - atan_r(b / a))

next_speed.body: if drive = "ahead" then (if v < 0 then min(v + 2, 0) else min(v + 1, 8)) else if drive = "back" then (if v > 0 then max(v - 2, 0) else max(v - 1, -8)) else (if v > 0 then max(v - 2, 0) else min(v + 2, 0))

perp.body: if abs(norm180(bearing - 90)) < abs(norm180(bearing + 90)) then norm180(bearing - 90) else norm180(bearing + 90)

turn_by.body: if turn = "left" then -m else if turn = "right" then m else if turn = "toward_enemy" then clamp(s.enemy_bearing, -m, m) else if turn = "away_from_enemy" then clamp(norm180(s.enemy_bearing + 180), -m, m) else if turn = "perpendicular" then clamp(perp(s.enemy_bearing), -m, m) else 0

gun_by.body: if gun = "aim" then clamp(s.gun_bearing, -20, 20) else if gun = "sweep_left" then -20 else if gun = "sweep_right" then 20 else 0

nearest.body: if count(es) = 0 then null else es[dist(b.x, b.y, item.x, item.y) = min(for e in es return dist(b.x, b.y, e.x, e.y))][1]

sense.body: sense_with(b, nearest(b, enemies(b, bots)), count(enemies(b, bots)))

sense_with.body: {id: b.id, enemy_distance: if e = null then 9999 else decimal(dist(b.x, b.y, e.x, e.y), 1), enemy_bearing: if e = null then 0 else decimal(norm180(angle_to(e.x - b.x, e.y - b.y) - b.heading), 1), gun_bearing: if e = null then 0 else decimal(norm180(angle_to(e.x - b.x, e.y - b.y) - b.gun), 1), enemy_in_sight: if e = null then false else abs(norm180(angle_to(e.x - b.x, e.y - b.y) - b.gun)) <= 10, my_energy: decimal(b.energy, 1), enemy_energy: if e = null then 0 else decimal(e.energy, 1), near_wall: b.x + 80 * sin_d(b.heading) < 18 or b.x + 80 * sin_d(b.heading) > arena_w() - 18 or b.y - 80 * cos_d(b.heading) < 18 or b.y - 80 * cos_d(b.heading) > arena_h() - 18, wall_distance: decimal(min(b.x, b.y, arena_w() - b.x, arena_h() - b.y) - 18, 1), gun_ready: b.heat <= 0, was_hit: b.hit, speed: b.v, enemies_left: n}

move.body: place(b, a, modulo(b.heading + turn_by(a.turn, s, max_turn(b.v)), 360), next_speed(b.v, a.drive), modulo(b.gun + gun_by(a.gun, s), 360), a.fire >= 0.1 and b.heat <= 0 and b.energy > a.fire)

place.body: walled(b, a, h, v, g, fires, b.x + v * sin_d(h), b.y - v * cos_d(h))

walled.body: {id: b.id, x: clamp(nx, 18, arena_w() - 18), y: clamp(ny, 18, arena_h() - 18), heading: h, v: if nx < 18 or nx > arena_w() - 18 or ny < 18 or ny > arena_h() - 18 then 0 else nv, gun: g, energy: b.energy - (if fires then clamp(a.fire, 0.1, 3) else 0) - (if nx < 18 or nx > arena_w() - 18 or ny < 18 or ny > arena_h() - 18 then max(0, abs(nv) * 0.5 - 1) else 0), heat: if fires then 1 + clamp(a.fire, 0.1, 3) / 5 else max(0, b.heat - 0.1), alive: b.alive, rule: a.rule, hit: false, damage: b.damage, fired: if fires then clamp(a.fire, 0.1, 3) else 0, died: b.died}

resting.body: {id: b.id, x: b.x, y: b.y, heading: b.heading, v: 0, gun: b.gun, energy: b.energy, heat: b.heat, alive: false, rule: 0, hit: false, damage: b.damage, fired: 0, died: b.died}

fly.body: {owner: u.owner, x: decimal(u.x + bullet_speed(u.power) * sin_d(u.heading), 2), y: decimal(u.y - bullet_speed(u.power) * cos_d(u.heading), 2), heading: u.heading, power: u.power}

hits.body: b.alive and b.id != u.owner and dist(u.x, u.y, b.x, b.y) < 18

out.body: u.x < 0 or u.x > arena_w() or u.y < 0 or u.y > arena_h()

spawn.body: {owner: b.id, x: decimal(b.x + 20 * sin_d(b.gun), 2), y: decimal(b.y - 20 * cos_d(b.gun), 2), heading: b.gun, power: b.fired}

step.body: resolve(w, for b in w.bots return if b.alive then advance(b, sense(b, w.bots)) else resting(b), for u in w.bullets return fly(u))

resolve.body: {tick: w.tick + 1, bots: for b in moved return settle(b, w.bots[item.id = b.id][1], moved, flown, w.tick + 1), bullets: concatenate(flown[not(out(item)) and not(hits_any(item, moved))], for b in moved[item.fired > 0] return spawn(b))}

settle.body: finish(b, old, tick, total(for u in flown return if hits(u, b) then bullet_damage(u.power) else 0), total(for u in flown return if u.owner = b.id and hits_any(u, moved) then bullet_damage(u.power) else 0), total(for u in flown return if u.owner = b.id and hits_any(u, moved) then 3 * u.power else 0), b.alive and count(moved[item.alive and item.id != b.id and dist(item.x, item.y, b.x, b.y) < 36]) > 0)

finish.body: {id: b.id, x: decimal(if rammed then old.x else b.x, 2), y: decimal(if rammed then old.y else b.y, 2), heading: decimal(b.heading, 2), v: if rammed then 0 else b.v, gun: decimal(b.gun, 2), energy: decimal(max(0, b.energy - taken + gain - (if rammed then 0.6 else 0)), 2), heat: decimal(b.heat, 2), alive: b.alive and b.energy - taken + gain - (if rammed then 0.6 else 0) > 0, rule: b.rule, hit: taken > 0, damage: decimal(b.damage + dealt, 2), fired: b.fired, died: if b.alive and b.energy - taken + gain - (if rammed then 0.6 else 0) <= 0 then tick else b.died}

run.body: if k <= 0 then [] else concatenate([w], run(step(w), k - 1))
